title: Driver app UI polish to client-presentable standard (indigo brand, consistent inputs, status chips, timeline, states)
goal: The driver app looks like the same product as the desktop (indigo #4F46E5 / dark #818CF8), with consistent inputs, clear primary actions, status chips, a trip timeline and proper loading/empty/error states in light and dark.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Evidence: desktop/audit/fix/shots/driver-01-launch.png, driver-04-login-dark.png. lib/app/theme.dart seeds #1565C0; lib/core/constants/app_colors.dart hard-codes status colours (assigned = orange); phone_input_screen.dart: country-code dropdown is outlined while the phone field is filled (different heights); Send OTP button is a muted grey-blue that reads as disabled; car icon keeps the light-theme primary in dark mode; no branded app name/splash (launch_background.xml). Keep every widget Key added in B03 (STORYBOARD D.6) and the Key('check-in-coords') text. l10n: lib/l10n/intl_{en,hi,ar}.arb with flutter `generate: true`.
steps: theme.dart: Material 3 ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: Color(0xFF4F46E5), brightness: light) and a dark scheme (seed 0xFF818CF8 or fromSeed dark) ; shared component themes: FilledButton (min height 52, full-width in forms, distinct disabled style), OutlinedButton, InputDecorationTheme (filled, same radius/height for every input incl. dropdowns), Card, Chip, AppBar, NavigationBar, SnackBar. Text theme with clear hierarchy.

app_colors.dart -> replace raw status colours with a TripStatusStyle mapping derived from the colour scheme (light/dark aware): assigned -> primary, accepted -> blue/info, en_route -> amber, started/in_progress -> violet, completed -> green, cancelled/rejected -> red; each with container + on-container colours and an icon. trip_status_badge.dart uses it.

Login (phone_input_screen.dart, otp_verification_screen.dart): branded header (app name "TravelCRM Driver", tagline, icon tinted with colorScheme.primary in both themes), country code + phone in one consistent row, primary FilledButton, inline error text from state, OTP boxes consistent with the input theme, resend timer.

Trips (my_trips_screen.dart, trip_card.dart, trip_history_screen.dart): pull-to-refresh, skeleton loading cards, empty state per tab (icon + message + refresh), error state with retry, card layout: pickup time (large), pickup -> drop with route dots, passenger, vehicle registration chip, status chip; tap target >= 48dp.

Trip detail (trip_detail_screen.dart): header card (status chip, time, passenger with call button - tel: is fine in the driver app), locations with "Open in Maps" (map_launcher.dart), vehicle block, special instructions, a vertical timeline of status events (Assigned, Accepted, En route, Checked in / Started, Completed with local times), sticky bottom primary action per status (keep the action-* keys).
Check-in/out, profile, documents, edit profile: same component styles; documents list with status chips and expiry.
bottom_nav_shell.dart: NavigationBar with icons/labels; keep Key('nav-history').
Branding: android/app/src/main/res/values{,-night}/styles.xml + drawable launch_background.xml: indigo/dark background with a centred white icon or app name; android label already set in B03.
New user-facing strings go into intl_en.arb (and the same English text into intl_hi.arb / intl_ar.arb so generation succeeds); regenerate localizations (flutter gen-l10n or flutter pub get).
flutter analyze (0 issues) and flutter test pass. If an emulator is available, take before/after screenshots into desktop/audit/fix/shots/driver-polish-*.png (optional; B13 captures the formal set).
acceptance: flutter analyze clean; flutter test passes.
No hard-coded Color(0xFF1565C0)/orange status colours remain (grep app_colors/theme).
Light and dark themes both use the indigo seed.
notes: Visual reference: desktop ds tokens in desktop/src/app/globals.css (--ds-primary #4F46E5 light, #818CF8 dark; success/warning/danger/info hues).
